d1: The white parachutes drift slowly downward, the planes move across the sky, mist flows across the valley floor.
d6: The long line of porters walks slowly forward along the mountain path, the loaded bicycles roll, the torch flames flicker, mist drifts.
d8: The men pull the ropes together in rhythm, the heavy wheels turn slowly uphill, the torch flames flicker.
d12: The men dig with shovels and throw earth out of the trench, dust rises, clouds move slowly.
d14: Heavy rain falls, the water in the trench ripples, the men huddle together and eat.
d20: The flag waves in the wind, the children walk along the path, the grass sways.
